name: The Cozy Cat Cafe
description: A Christmas wishlist inspired by a cozy rescue cat cafe, filled with resident kitties, warm drinks and festive charm.

mascot.name: Biscuit
mascot.idle: Biscuit the orange tabby sitting patiently
mascot.happy: Biscuit the orange tabby happily raising a paw
mascot.sad: Biscuit the orange tabby looking disappointed

text.title: The Cozy Cat Café
text.welcome: Come on in, grab something warm, and make yourself at home! Everything here is on my Christmas wishlist. Cat's Favorites are my most wanted gifts. Tap the {i} on a photo for sizes, colors and notes.
text.footer: Made with love, a little coffee, and an unreasonable amount of cat hair.
text.lootedNote: This gift has found its home!
text.planner.idle: Welcome to my little corner of the café! Give me a budget and I'll find some lovely gifts for you.
text.planner.claimHint: Found something you like? Claim it on its card so nobody buys it twice.
text.empty.title: Not even a whisker!
text.empty.text: Nothing matches those filters. Try changing them and we'll have another look.
